units.source_text: 前面小格子窗那边的二楼，天花板很低矮，是间让学徒工睡觉的简陋的房子。

en.t: The second floor by the small lattice window at the front had a very low ceiling and was a plain room where the apprentices slept.

units.source_text: 从中院边上的走廊可以直通到后面二楼，从店铺里也可以登上去。

en.t: A corridor beside the inner courtyard led straight to the rear second floor, and one could also go up from inside the shop.

units.source_text: 那儿通常是用作招待主要顾客或留客住宿的。

en.t: That space was usually used to receive important customers or to put guests up for the night.

units.source_text: 如今接待一般顾客洽谈生意，也都在对着中院的客厅里。

en.t: Nowadays even ordinary customers were received for business talks in the reception room facing the inner courtyard.

units.source_text: 虽说是客厅，其实是从店铺直接连到后面的过厅，过厅两侧放着堆满和服绸缎的橱架。

en.t: Although it was called a reception room, it was really a passage room leading directly from the shop to the back, with shelves piled with kimono silks on both sides.
The room was long and wide.

units.source_text: 摊开衣料供顾客挑选也比较方便。

en.t: It was also convenient for spreading out fabrics and letting customers choose from them.
Rattan mats were spread there all year round.
